sourceFacts.leaf: Visible single partly open arched-top wooden leaf with vertical planks and one sloping crossbar. Hinge mechanics and rear thickness are not visible and are not invented.
sourceFacts.footCaveat: These are visible lower timber/frame contacts, not a certified hidden foundation or hardware pivot. Source outer antialias is soft; polygon boundaries are an explicit approximate vector reconstruction from that visible silhouette.

Left free edge is intentionally in aperture. Exact unseen hinge is unproved.
v2Connection.capMismatch: Old upper-right cap1340,850 and1344,853 falls on v2 arch/soffit material with later virtual support~912..911 than wood897.5..899.5. Existing local depth therefore predicts this small top-cap portion remains hidden under the new stone arch. This is an explicit new-arch/old-leaf interface difference, not a full old silhouette pass. Do not force whole leaf always-on-top or move frozen ground samples to conceal it.
v2Connection.bottom: At1348,900 v2 is onlyA1 and original wood bottom1349,902 is outside stone; independent wood extends down naturally to its original visible lower line. No invisible wooden support extension below902 is proposed.
v2Connection.noFloatingClaim: Geometric overlap establishes a plausible attachment region, not proof of a hidden hinge or mechanical mount. Same-camera preview should confirm no visible seam/unsupported isolated sliver at the curved cap.

continuousRoadPreservation.result: Proposed full wood+crossbar polygons intersect NONE of the frozen source-road region integer samples. Keep those native region checks unchanged; do not substitute only the three ground witnesses.
